name: Celestia Example World
author: Celestia Metal Contributors
description: A minimal world pack: Celestia Native's renderer with its own sky shader (shaders/sky.fs.metal) and a compiled-in tint option. Copy it as a starting point for your own pack.

options.label: Sky Tint
options.description: Colour the sky is tinted towards. Compiled into the pack's MSL: changing it rebuilds the world shaders.

options.label: Sky Tint Strength
options.description: How far the sky moves towards the tint colour (0 = Celestia Native's sky).

options.label: Shadows
options.description: An engine option this pack chooses to expose (same id as Celestia Native's). Undeclared engine options keep Celestia Native's defaults.
